items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: About my brother, we had an orchestra. I played with him for quite a while. It was the original cloverleaf.

ctx.x: Joseph. Uh-huh. You mentioned a minute ago you had a brother too that played trumpet. Yeah, he played trumpet.
Was he older or younger? He's older, one year older. One year older. Uh-huh. Did your mother play anything? No, my mom never played nothing.
